field.label: Enable
field.help: Run the Checkmk agent for queries from a Checkmk server.

field.label: Listen address
field.help: IP address of this firewall on which the agent accepts queries. The default 127.0.0.1 allows only local queries, e.g. via SSH. Use 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4 addresses or :: for all IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. With high availability, the settings are synchronized, so use ::, 0.0.0.0 or a CARP address here.

field.label: Listen port
field.help: TCP port of the agent. Checkmk queries port 6556 by default.

field.label: Encryption
field.help: Encrypt the agent output with the secret below. On the Checkmk server, enter the same secret in the rule "Symmetric encryption (Linux, Windows)".

field.label: Encryption secret
field.help: The secret is stored in the configuration and is never shown again. Leave this field empty to keep the current secret.
